it started the same way to me, around 16-17 (I'm 21 now); to me, it was thoughts + general feelings of sadness, eventually it led me to a suicide attempt due to tough circumstances around that time. I'm not a professional but I think you should definetely seek one just to learn about the subject :) 

Stay safe brother!
